creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -B assets/audio/bgm_blood_sea/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 and NumPy 2.5.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python). The output parent directory must exist.
patch: PCG64 seed 6131. Bowed low voice: ten-harmonic additive saw with slow 0.32 s bow swell, 4.4 Hz vibrato and seeded rosin grit. Unstable upper voice: two detuned beating sines plus a wandering inharmonic partial, drifting pitch and irregular tremor. Seeded low-passed breath swells. Notes, releases and cross-channel reflections wrap modulo the loop. All oscillator phases start at zero. Master gain 1.55, nearest-even PCM16 quantization without dither.
tuning: E Phrygian-leaning set (E F G A B C), tonal center E, A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: Bowed fundamentals sit at E2-B2; unstable voice fundamentals G3-F4. Measured mono energy share 450-1600 Hz is -10.8 dB of total (the bronze warning register is left comparatively open for sfx_tell_boss/sfx_counter), 1.6-5 kHz -18.7 dB.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: The preceding bar's bowed and breath tails are already sounding at frame zero and continue across the final frame; frame 0 equals the continuation of frame 3527999.

verification.rebuild: Two independent render processes wrote to separate empty directories (together with the eight SFX). Master WAV and all SFX WAV and provenance bytes matched.
